title: Amelia | Contemporary Block Heel Sandal
bodyHtml:
Step into effortless style with our contemporary block heel sandal—designed for the woman who wants to look polished without any fuss. The wide, stable heel keeps you comfortable all day long, whilst the adjustable ankle strap ensures a secure fit that works with your pace. With an open, breezy silhouette and a modern graphic block heel, this is the versatile shoe that takes you from weekend brunch in Brisbane to weekday errands around town.

Why you'll love it

  • Wide, stable heel delivers all-day comfort without compromising on style
  • Adjustable ankle strap for a personalised, secure fit that stays put
  • Open design keeps your feet cool on warm days—perfect year-round
  • Graphic block heel adds contemporary edge to any outfit
  • Effortless to slip on and off, yet looks intentional and put-together
  • Works just as well with linen trousers as it does with a sundress
  • That hard-to-find balance between comfort and contemporary design

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
